content.text:
Calling `clone()` on a mesh, line or points object now gives the copy its own materials array. The material objects inside it are still shared with the original, as the issue asked. I haven't run any tests or tried it.

The change is the same one line in each of `copy()` in `src/objects/Mesh.js`, `src/objects/Line.js` and `src/objects/Points.js`:

```js
this.material = Array.isArray( source.material ) ? source.material.slice() : source.material;
```

When the source has a single material rather than an array, the reference is copied as before. I left `Sprite` alone because a sprite only ever has one material.
